description: Find a person's mobile phone number from their LinkedIn profile URL, via Wiza. Starts an individual reveal and polls it inline (bounded to ~10s) so you get one synchronous answer. Example: wiza_find_phone({ profile_url: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/patrickcollison/", _apiKey: "your-wiza-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Wiza API key (find it on your Wiza account API page).

profile_url.description: The person's LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. "https://www.linkedin.com/in/patrickcollison/".

name: wiza_find_phone
title: Wiza Find Phone
